a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs about 3 storm-free rounds, so it has under a 1% chance of saving either of us. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you so rather than surprising you. If you'd rather contest it, we both risk a random split and both could fail. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round afterward to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round because the storm odds make the 8-cell plan nearly hopeless. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you short. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round from now on to help rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
